response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaType, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT MediaType, avg_bpms, avg_bpms - (SELECT AVG(avg_bpms) FROM per_type) AS diff_from_overall FROM per_type WHERE avg_bpms > (SELECT AVG(avg_bpms) FROM per_type)

assumptions.assumption: 'Pass a cutoff of 10,323,804 bytes' means Bytes >= 10323804 (inclusive).
The overall average is the simple mean of per-media-type averages, computed only over media types that have at least one qualifying track. Per-track ratio uses real division, not integer division.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is strict: only tracks with Bytes > 10323804 qualify.
